text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I couldn't win this time either...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ugh. I'll be forgotten entirely at this
rate.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Actually... I might already be forgotten.
Does
anyone even know I'm here?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes... That's right. Your eyes are lenses
made to
focus on me.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Thank you. I feel a bit better now.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
You're right. There's no need to rush. I'll
just keep
at it.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...That way, I can grace your lens with a
winning
smile next time.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, we are. If I can win next time, I'll really rev up everyone's hearts. Vroom vroom.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It'll be a great opportunity to take a
huge leap
towards becoming a super
ultra mascot.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
We'll have to put Machan dolls into
mass
production... for certain!
